title: Recursive midpoint relation
statement: Fix a width $w$ and a relation $E$ on pairs of Boolean lists. Define a relation recursively on the level and endpoint lists: at level zero it is $E(A,B)$; at level $r+1$, it holds when there is a Boolean list $z$ of length $w$ such that the level-$r$ relation holds from $A$ to $z$ and from $z$ to $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Relation E on pairs of Boolean lists
